dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Sheecago arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, she has been observed to be fearful and kennel reactive. Noted to hard bark at handlers when approached and will cage fight significantly. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only, single pet home with no trips to the dog park.
dog.name: Sheecago
